It preserves the existing summation logic and leaves peak calculation untouched. This satisfies the crash fix while maintaining output shape and correctly handling windows with zero usable samples.

None. The guard directly addresses the `ZeroDivisionError` without altering the report format or misrepresenting data accounting for empty windows (which contain no usable samples). The host measurements already confirm structural, acceptance, and veto checks pass.
